ipos_summary: The firm says nine IPOs. Its count rose in step with these listings: six by 2007 (the firm's own exits page), seven in the December 2019 boilerplate (after NFON), eight in June 2022 (after UiPath), nine from 2025 (after Oculis). The nine above reproduce that count; the firm has not published the list itself, so the mapping of 7, 8 and 9 is inferred from the timing. In scope without UiPath: eight. Trade sales: the firm counts 41 (June 2026), up from 24 in 2019; the largest it names is ImCheck Therapeutics to Ipsen at up to EUR 1 billion (October 2025).
